column1: # SPCS2022 zone catalog for io.github.pennstatecs.geokit.crs.CrsRegistry (format: CrsCatalogCsv KDoc).
# Intentionally EMPTY. As of 2026-11 the SPCS2022 zones are not in the EPSG dataset (v12.029) or
# transformation in GeoKit. Every SPCS2022 lookup therefore reports "unsupported".
# To add zones once NGS/EPSG publish final definitions: see docs/geodesy/reference-frames-roadmap.md
# (section 3.4) and libs/geokit-core/README.md. Rows stay non-operational until verified_by names
# checked-in reference vectors that a geokit-core test verifies.
